author: Stimulating
body:
As you can see, I was considering joining a team as Offence. I have Solid PvP skills and can handle myself well in 1v1 scenarios. I have good MS. I'm confident in my parkour skills. I keep a calm head and can get along with teammates well. I can be inconsistant though. Readily available most of the time.  I've played on the server for almost 12 days now. I can adapt to other positions as well.

Skype: live:grouchyfrog (email from when I was 7, lol)
Very active on Skype. 
 
I have little experience in scrims, but I can make several types of cannons, and can hold my own in PvP and I can also see opportunities when they arise to get an objective, or gain control over an area of the map and can work skybridges well.

I also know a little about defence. Infinity was too inactive, so I'm looking for an active team who scrims. I also can lead and make calls and have a voice that projects well from playing Sports. I used to be Co-Leader of Be Scurred, voted in, so I can organize and pick up good players as well. 

I'm actually chill when I get to know you :)
